headline: Chelsea's Xabi Alonso: Thibaut Courtois sees himself in Mike Penders
description: Xabi Alonso believes understudy goalkeeper Mike Penders is ready for an extended spell in Chelsea's team after consulting on the 21-year-old with Thibaut Courtois.

headline: Arsenal's Mikel Arteta admits Bukayo Saka injury signs are 'not good'
description: Mikel Arteta did not deny Bukayo Saka's injury could be significant after the winger's struggles appeared to indicate "not good signs" for his prognosis.

description: Man United boss Michael Carrick gives emotional address to media

headline: Highest-earning Premier League clubs to pay up to £1.8m towards independent regulator cost
description: The highest-earning Premier League clubs will pay up to £1.8million towards the cost of the independent football regulator (IFR) from next summer -- but could face paying much higher amounts in the years ahead.

headline: Liverpool's Andoni Iraola urges Rio Ngumoha not to be distracted by 'outside noise'
description: Liverpool boss Andoni Iraola has urged Rio Ngumoha not to be distracted by the outside noise following his impressive performance against Villarreal.

headline: Carrick refuses to rule out dropping Bruno Fernandes for Man United clash with Bournemouth
description: Michael Carrick has refused to rule out dropping Bruno Fernandes for Bournemouth's visit to Old Trafford on Sunday after the Manchester United captain appeared to criticise his tactics following the defeat to Como.
